facts.text: Under the Cleveland State Commitment, qualifying Ohio first-year students with a family adjusted gross income of $125,000 or less and high school GPA of 3.0 or higher receive last-dollar coverage for tuition.

sources.title: $0 Tuition for Hardworking Ohio Students - Cleveland State University
sources.quote: Spring 2027 high school graduate with a GPA of 3.0 or higher.

sources.title: $0 Tuition for Hardworking Ohio Students - Cleveland State University
sources.quote: Family adjusted gross income of $125,000 or less, confirmed each year through the FAFSA.

sources.title: $0 Tuition for Hardworking Ohio Students - Cleveland State University
sources.quote: CSU covers any tuition remaining after federal and state grants and scholarships are applied.
